title: The More I Research Chainlink, the Less I Want the LINK Token
description:
In this Chainlink LINK crypto review, I give Chainlink one of the fairest but hardest reviews I can. I explain why I believe Chainlink has built real business value through oracles, interoperability, price feeds, and integrations, while also arguing that the LINK token itself has a major weakness: token holders do not own the business, control the roadmap, or have legal claim to the cash flows.

I compare LINK to ICP and explain why I believe ICP is the stronger long-term opportunity if crypto is going to make meaningful progress in the world. I also break down why I do not view LINK as a true AI coin, why I think the token can act like a fake stock without stockholder rights, and why the valuation gap between LINK and ICP looks backwards to me.
